The BDCOM S2900-24T4X 24-Port Gigabit Switch with 4 SFP Ports is a high-performance Layer 2+ controlled switch intended for enterprise networks, campus deployments, and service providers who require secure, scalable, and dependable connectivity. It has 24 Gigabit RJ45 ports and four 10GE/GE SFP uplink interfaces, providing a switching capability of 128 Gbps and a forwarding rate of 96 Mpps. Multicast management consists of IGMP v1/v2/v3, IGMP snooping, MVR, IGMP fast leave, and filtering. The BDCOM S2900-24T4X 24 Port Gigabit Switch supports IPv4 and IPv6 dual stack, with strong IPv6 features such as ICMPv6, DHCPv6, ACLv6, neighbor and path MTU detection, MLD v1, MLD snooping, and numerous tunneling methods. The BDCOM S2900-24T4X 24 Port Gigabit Switch's security features include port isolation, MAC sticky, DHCP snooping with option 82, DAI, IP source guard, PPPoE+, 802.1x authentication, and protection against DoS attacks and broadcast storms. TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Stackable L3 Managed Switch with SFP Port

The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Stackable L3 Managed Switch with SFP Port is a high-performance enterprise networking solution. Built for SMBs, enterprises, and ISPs that need scalable, reliable, and feature-rich Layer 3 switching at the network convergence layer. It delivers 128 Gbps switching capacity per unit with 24 Gigabit RJ45 ports and four 10 Gbps SFP+ slots for fast and flexible wired connectivity. This TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Managed Switch supports physical stacking of up to 8 units, dual redundant power supplies, and full Omada SDN integration for centralized cloud management.

Port Configuration

The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Switch provides 24 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 ports and four 10G SFP+ slots for high-density wired connectivity across enterprise network deployments. A switching capacity of 128 Gbps per unit and a packet forwarding rate of 95.2 Mpps ensure the switch handles demanding traffic loads without bottlenecks during peak operation. A 32K MAC address table, 3MB packet buffer memory, and 9KB jumbo frame support enable efficient and high-volume data processing across all connected devices. Two USB 2.0 ports, one RJ45 console port, one USB Type-C console port, and one dedicated RJ45 management port provide comprehensive access and configuration options.

Switching Performance

Physical stacking supports up to 4 units per stack group with each 10G SFP+ uplink port usable as a stacking port at 20 Gbps full-duplex stack bandwidth. This stacking capability scales the network to 8 units for built-in redundancy and expanded port density without complex configuration changes. The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Managed Switch uses Store-and-Forward transmission for reliable and error-free packet delivery across all connected network segments. Four internal fixed fans and a maximum power consumption of 28.4W at 220V ensure efficient and thermally managed continuous operation.

Layer 3 Routing

The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Switch delivers comprehensive Layer 3 routing capabilities including Static Routing, RIP v1/v2, OSPF v2/v3, ECMP with up to 32 nexthops per destination, VRRP v2/v3, and DHCP Server and Relay for scalable network architectures. IPv4 supports up to 256 IP interfaces, 1024 static routes, and a host route table of up to 6100 entries for extensive routing table capacity. PIM-DM and PIM-SM multicast routing protocols ensure efficient multicast traffic delivery across complex network topologies. DHCP Server supports up to 8K IP pools and 1000 manual binding entries for comprehensive address management in large network deployments.

Layer 2 Features

With Layer 2 features include Link Aggregation, Spanning Tree Protocol, ERPS for ring topology protection and recovery, Port Mirroring, RSPAN, and 802.3x Flow Control for robust and resilient network operation. IGMP Snooping, MLD Snooping, Multicast VLAN Registration, and support for 2048 IGMP groups deliver efficient multicast traffic management across the network. Up to 4K VLAN groups using 802.1Q, MAC VLAN, Protocol VLAN, QinQ, Voice VLAN, Private VLAN, and GVRP provide extensive traffic segmentation capabilities. The TP-Link Managed Switch also supports 802.3ah Ethernet Link OAM, L2PT, DLDP, DDM, and sFlow for comprehensive ISP-grade feature coverage.

products.description:
TP-Link SG2218P Omada 18-Port Gigabit Smart Switch with 16-Port PoE+

The TP-Link SG2218P Omada 18-Port Gigabit Smart Switch with 16-Port PoE+ is a robust networking solution for enterprises that require consistent performance, centralized control, and enhanced security features. With 16 Gigabit 802.3af/at PoE+ ports and 2 Gigabit SFP slots, it has a total PoE power budget of 150 W, with up to 30 W per port for powering IP cameras, access points, or VoIP phones. The TP-Link SG2218P Omada 18-Port Gigabit Switch has a switching capacity of 36 Gbps and a forwarding rate of 26.78 Mpps, ensuring efficient data transmission over demanding networks. Its sturdy design includes a strong metal shell, a rackmountable form factor, and efficient cooling with a built-in fan, making it ideal for enterprise situations. Network administrators can benefit from centralized cloud management via the Omada app or Omada hardware, software, and cloud-based controllers, which enable seamless zero-touch provisioning, batch configuration, and intelligent monitoring. The TP-Link SG2218P Omada 18-Port Gigabit Switch also allows for autonomous management via web, CLI, SNMP, and RMON for increased versatility. Advanced Layer 2 and Layer 2+ capabilities include static routing, DHCP server and relay, link aggregation, spanning tree protocol, VLAN support for up to 4K groups, and IGMP snooping to improve multicast performance. Enhanced security features such as IP-MAC-Port binding, 802.1X authentication, DoS protection, port isolation, DHCP snooping, ARP inspection, and HTTPS and SSH secure management help to guard against network threats. QoS capabilities such as 802.1p CoS/DSCP priority, bandwidth management, and storm control assure consistent performance for voice, video, and data traffic. The TP-Link SG2218P Omada 18-Port Gigabit Switch also supports IPv6, with static routing, ACLs, MLD snooping, and a dual IPv4/IPv6 stack. It is CE, FCC, and RoHS certified, and works with most major operating systems, including Windows, macOS, Linux, and UNIX. With intelligent device detection, system diagnostics, and dual image configuration, the TP-Link SG2218P Omada switch is an excellent solution for scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise networking.

Priority Video Quality Guaranteed & One-Click Traffic Separation for Ports 1-8

Quality of sensitive applications like video monitoring in critical business areas is guaranteed by offering higher priority options for ports 1–2 when one-touch Priority Mode is on. With one click, Isolation Mode easily divides traffic for ports 1–8 to avoid snooping and tampering. Intelligent Power Management

When overall power usage surpasses 65 W, intelligent power management reduces the power to the lower priority ports. Durable Metal Casing

products.description:
Zyxel MES 3500-24F 24-port FE Fiber L2 Switch with Four GbE Combo Port

Consistent service quality and reliable connecting ability in a converged network is the key for Carrier to connect and satisfy customers; therefore the ability to control traffic flow and set traffic policy becomes more critical than ever. The Zyxel MES3500 series offers wire-speed flow control that classifies and prioritizes the incoming packets according to the predefine QoS policies that meet the requirements of service providers. In terms of classification, the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) field and the 802.1p Class of Service (CoS) field are identified to assess the priority of incoming packets. Classification and reclassification can be based on criteria as specific as rules based on IP, MAC addresses, VLAN ID, or TCP/UDP port number. For bandwidth management, the MES3500 series provides 8 priority queues per port for different types of traffics, allowing service providers to set policy-based rate limitations that take full advantage of constrained network resources and guarantee the best performance. Avoiding subscribers affecting each other on a shared network or shared device is a major concern for service providers. The Zyxel MES3500 series offers a complete set of security features to protect user data while administrating the traffics. Port security provides the ability to deny unauthorized users from accessing the network. Moreover, the 802.1X feature cooperating with RADIUS is useful to prevent unauthorized access based on username and password (or other credentials) and acts as powerful access control for converged networks with mixed wired and wireless access. The MES3500 series provides a multilayer (L2/L3/L4) ACL suite of sophisticated policy-based control mechanisms that enables service providers to deploy easily based on actual network environment needs via a Web GUI or command-line interface to prevent abnormal or illegal access. The policies can be defined to deny packets based on source and destination MAC addresses, IP addresses, or TCP/UDP ports. A quick recovery and round-the-clock network are vital for service providers to establish a robust network. The MES3500 series provides comprehensive features to make sure the network is well operated. The IEEE 802.3ad Link Aggregation feature reduces network downtime by providing redundant paths and bandwidth aggregation to critical connections, while IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (RSTP) and IEEE 802.1s Multiple Spanning Tree Protocol (MSTP) allow immediate recovery from failed connections by sending packets via the backup link. The enhanced digital interface allows real-time access to the device operating parameters, and it includes optional digital features such as soft control and monitoring of SFP I/O signals. In addition, the MES3500 series fully incorporates the functionality needed to implement digital alarms and warnings from fault isolation and failure prediction tasks as well as component monitoring features, among others. With the digital diagnostic monitoring interface, the MES3500 series enables users to easily detect packet loss from transceivers and aging cables; therefore users can not only avoid troubles such as unstable networking services but also boost productivity significantly. As Zyxel considers IPv6 management features as a future trend, complete IPv6 host management capabilities are added to the MES3500 series for guaranteed IPv6/4 migration and future-proof expansion. Itâ€™s not only beneficial for high-density Fast Ethernet deployments but also capable of preventing investment loss and therefore perfectly suitable for both network cores and edges.

Asus ROG Rapture GT-AX11000 Pro Tri-Band 11000 Mbps Gigabit WiFi Gaming Router

The Asus ROG Rapture GT-AX11000 Pro Tri-Band Gigabit WiFi Gaming Router eliminates lag and latency. This tri-band router, which is primarily aimed at gamers and enthusiasts looking to optimize their high-speed internet and network device connections, takes Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) performance to the next level with up to 10,756 Mb/s total wireless data throughput. At the same time, RangeBoost Plus technology aids in coverage expansion, while built-in game acceleration capabilities enhance online gaming experiences.

Boosted Wi-Fi 6 Performance

The Asus ROG Rapture GT-AX11000 Pro Tri-Band Gigabit WiFi Gaming Router By taking advantage of the 160 MHz channel, the ROG GT-AX11000 Pro delivers up to 4804 Mb/s data transfers on each of its two 5 GHz bands with compatible devices while the 2.4 GHz frequency supports 1148 Mb/s. This increases the backhaul capacity of mesh networks while improving the overall signal efficiency for roaming and coverage. Additional features include a 2 GHz quad-core 64-bit CPU that helps to provide smooth signal processing.

Wide Coverage

The Asus ROG Rapture GT-AX11000 Pro Tri-Band Gigabit WiFi Gaming Router Eight powerful antennas line the outside of this high-performance gaming router with 4x4 MU-MIMO technology ensuring simultaneous connections to up to 12 devices. At the same time, OFDMA divides each wireless channel into smaller sub-channels for greater reach and efficiency. ASUS AiMesh support allows you to create a mesh network by adding compatible routers to your network as satellites to expand coverage. A mesh network operates using a single network ID (SSID) and automatically hands your device's connection to the satellite with the strongest signal to ensure uninterrupted connections as you stream 4K videos and play online games while moving from room to room. RangeBoost Plus features also help to expand coverage by up to 38% compared to previous-generation Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) routers.

Flexible Network Ports

The Asus ROG Rapture GT-AX11000 Pro Tri-Band Gigabit WiFi Gaming Router with taking full advantage of multi-Gig internet connections with the 2.5G Ethernet WAN port. The ROG GT-AX11000 Pro also includes a configurable 10G LAN / WAN port that allows you to transfer data at blazing speeds with compatible computers, network devices, and storage drives. Four Gigabit speed LAN ports are also available. Link aggregation support allows you to combine two ports, providing you with massive bandwidth to connect devices and internet services. Connect compatible storage drives to the USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 and 2.0 ports to share photos, videos, and other files with all devices across the network. You can also attach a mobile 3G/4G LTE network dongle or Android device as a backup internet connection.

Triple-Level Game Acceleration

The Asus ROG Rapture GT-AX11000 Pro Tri-Band Gigabit WiFi Gaming Router with Integrated technologies helps to stabilize your connection, boost your online experiences, and increase network speeds with jitter prevention, lag reduction, and ping improvement. Connecting your computer or console system to the designated gaming Ethernet port prioritizes its traffic above all other devices. At the same time, Game Boost optimizes your connection by automatically prioritizing gaming-related packets above tasks such as media streaming, web browsing, and file transfers. The Gamer VPN feature finds the shortest path to your preferred game server. Use the ASUS Router app to enable mobile game mode on your router, which minimizes latency and lag with wireless devices. Using the OpenNAT feature allows you to join your clan by configuring port forwarding in three easy steps instead of dealing with complicated procedures.

Complete Security

In addition to WPA3 wireless encryption, support for VPN technology through the ASUS Guard app provides you with peace of mind when connected to public Wi-Fi hotspots at restaurants, hotels, and airports. By creating a secure tunnel to your ROG GT-AX11000 Pro at home, you can enjoy secure connections from almost anywhere in the world. AiProtection Pro offers commercial-grade security with features such as malicious site blocking and infected device detection and quarantining. Advanced parental controls let you configure profiles and schedules for each of your family members, limiting online access for specified devices. Firmware updates are downloaded and installed automatically. The ROG GT-AX11000 Pro also works with Alexa-enabled devices to perform tasks such as enabling the guest network when visitors arrive.

Cudy M1800 AX1800 Whole Home Mesh WiFi 6 Router (1 Pack)

The Cudy M1800 AX1800 Whole Home Mesh WiFi Router features High-Performance Dual Core CPU with 32MB Flash and 256MB DDR3. It comes with 5 x Gigabit Ethernet Ports and it has 4 x 5dBi High Gain Antennas. 4x5dBi High gain antennas boost the sensitivity of the WiFi router, create connections over greater distances, providing powerful penetration through walls. 2.4GHz provides an extremely long-range, 5GHz reaches 1201Mbps, ideal for gaming and 4K streaming. Simple tasks like web browsing can be handled by the 2.4GHz band, while bandwidth-intensive tasks like online gaming or HD video streaming can be processed by the 5GHz band at the same time. It is a 2-IN-1 WiFi Router / Access Point. When working in router mode, it can quickly establish a connection with the Internet through dial-up, so that all devices connected to it can enjoy high-speed networks. When working in the access point mode, usually a modem or router is required in front of it to dial and play the role of DHCP server, it only undertakes the role of data forwarding. The Cudy M1800 Router comes with built-in PPTP / L2TP VPN Clients, this router can easily establish a connection to VPN Server to transport all your online data and traffic, securing it with its encryption at the same time. You can use this function to connect your home network with your work network or school network. You can bind your home IP address to a custom domain name through the DDNS function. No matter how the IP changes, the domain name can point to your network, which makes remote management possible. The Cudy M1800 comes with a 1-year warranty.

products.description:
Cudy WR1200 AC1200 Dual-Band Smart Wi-Fi Router

The Cudy WR1200 AC1200 Dual Band Wi-Fi Router features High-Performance Dual Core CPU with 16MB Flash and 128MB DDR3. It has 4 x 5dBi High Gain Antennas. 4x5dBi High gain antennas boost the sensitivity of the WiFi router, create connections over greater distances, providing powerful penetration through walls. 2.4GHz provides extremely long-range, 5GHz reaches 867Mbps, ideal for gaming and 4K streaming. Simple tasks like web browsing can be handled by the 2.4GHz band, while bandwidth-intensive tasks like online gaming or HD video streaming can be processed by the 5GHz band at the same time. It is a 2-IN-1 WiFi Router / Access Point. When working in router mode, it can quickly establish a connection with the Internet through dial-up, so that all devices connected to it can enjoy high-speed networks. When working in the access point mode, usually a modem or router is required in front of it to dial and play the role of DHCP server, it only undertakes the role of data forwarding. The Cudy WR1200 with built-in PPTP / L2TP VPN Clients, this router can easily establish a connection to VPN Server to transport all your online data and traffic, securing it with its encryption at the same time. You can use this function to connect your home network with your work network or school network. You can bind your home IP address to a custom domain name through the DDNS function. No matter how the IP changes, the domain name can point to your network, which makes remote management possible. It comes with a 1-year warranty.

The MikroTik RB941-2nD hAP-Lite is a compact and versatile small home WiFi router with access point capabilities. Designed to cater to the connectivity needs of apartments, houses, or offices, this device packs a range of features to provide a reliable and secure wireless network. The hAP-Lite is the support for button-triggered WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup). This allows users to connect to the wireless network without the hassle of entering a complex password; they can simply press the WPS button on the device to establish a secure connection. The hAP-Lite can easily switch to cAP mode (CAPsMAN) with the press of a button. In cAP mode, it can join a centrally managed network, which is especially useful for larger setups with multiple access points that require centralized management and configuration. The hAP-Lite is powered by a capable 650MHz CPU and 32MB of RAM, ensuring smooth operation and efficient handling of network traffic. The dual-chain 2.4GHz onboard wireless allows for reliable and decent wireless coverage within its range. It also comes with four Fast Ethernet ports, providing wired connectivity for devices that require a stable and higher data transfer rate. The hAP-Lite runs on RouterOS, a powerful and feature-rich operating system developed by MikroTik. RouterOS offers a wide range of functionalities such as bandwidth shaping, firewall settings, user access control, and many others, making it a versatile tool for managing and securing your network. The hAP-Lite includes a RouterOS L4 license, which enables access to advanced features and capabilities. Additionally, it comes with a USB power supply, offering flexibility in powering the device. The MikroTik RB941-2nD hAP-Lite is a reliable and cost-effective solution for setting up a home or small office network. Its compact design, button-triggered WPS, and ability to join centrally managed networks make it easy to use and suitable for various networking needs. With its robust performance and feature-rich RouterOS, the hAP-Lite provides an excellent platform for creating a stable and secure wireless network.
